description: This file contains JavaScript code for Drupal's Views UI module, including behaviors, utility functions, class definitions, and event handlers to enhance the user interface for managing views in Drupal.

classes.name: Drupal.viewsUi.FormFieldFiller
classes.description: A utility class for prepopulating form fields based on the view label, with support for character exclusion, replacement, and suffix addition.

classes.name: Drupal.viewsUi.AddItemForm
classes.description: A class managing the add item form, handling checkbox interactions and display of selected items.

classes.name: Drupal.viewsUi.RearrangeFilterHandler
classes.description: A class that manages the rearrangement of filters in the views UI, including dynamic UI updates, drag-and-drop behavior, and filter group management.

classes.name: Drupal.viewsUi.OptionsSearch
classes.description: A class that filters options in the views UI based on user search input, supporting dynamic show/hide of options.

classes.name: Drupal.viewsUi.Checkboxifier
classes.description: A class that converts buttons into checkboxes, enabling toggle behavior for expose filters.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches behaviors to the DOM elements within the context, initializing UI interactions.

methods.name: rebind
methods.description: Rebinds event handlers to new form fields after AJAX updates.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates target form fields based on the source label, applying character exclusion and suffix.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Removes event handlers from form fields to prevent unwanted updates.

methods.name: handleCheck
methods.description: Handles checkbox toggle events, updating the list of selected items.

methods.name: refreshCheckedItems
methods.description: Updates the display of selected items in the UI.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a dropdown menu.

methods.name: handleFilter
methods.description: Filters options in the UI based on search input and group selection.

methods.name: redrawOperatorLabels
methods.description: Redraws the operator labels ('And'/'Or') next to filters based on current dropdown values.

methods.name: updateRowspans
methods.description: Updates the rowspan attributes of operator cells to reflect current filter group sizes.

methods.name: clickAddGroupButton
methods.description: Simulates clicking the add group button to insert a new filter group.

methods.name: clickRemoveGroupButton
methods.description: Simulates clicking the remove button for a filter group.

methods.name: duplicateGroupsOperator
methods.description: Duplicates the group operator dropdown between filter groups and manages their synchronization.

methods.name: syncGroupsOperators
methods.description: Ensures all duplicated group operator dropdowns stay in sync.

methods.name: operatorChangeHandler
methods.description: Handles change events on group operator dropdowns to synchronize their values.
